ns2:section.sectionText: This course prepares mentors to become a guide and support system for their first year, James Scholar mentees. Mentors will gain leadership, planning, and other skills to develop a positive relationship with a mentee.� The course is broken into two semesters (1 credit hour in the spring and 2 credit hours in the fall), nd it can be used as a James Scholar Project for both of those semesters.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Applied Health Sciences. Restricted to students with Junior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
